description_for_human: Demand form and catalog table of the canteen's food catalog

functions.name: open_demand_form
functions.description: Opens the demand form, an interactive form inside the conversation that lists every dish of the food catalog with a number input. Use it when the user wants to submit demand, plan an order or buy food.

functions.name: submit_demand
functions.description: Records the food demand: parallel arrays of food ids and quantities. Use it when the user states the quantities in chat.

functions.name: show_food_catalog
functions.description: Shows the food catalog as an interactive table with prices and stock inside the conversation.

functions.name: get_all_food_items
functions.description: Returns the full list of food items in the catalog with ids, prices and stock.
